_doc: Styles of the facilities agent's rooms (gTileset_Facility: Devon Corp, Stern's Shipyard, the harbors, the Space Center, the cable car stations, Mt. Pyre). Black 2 map textures only (src = a/0/1/4 texture set); every texture's palette is <tex>_pl in its set (checked).

fac_devon._doc: Devon Corp: Sapphire's red carpet with light squares = floor07 (texture set 288, Black 2's Nacrene/Castelia cafe-house floor); Sapphire's striped wallpaper over a wood wainscot = m_h05_kabe (349, the house style's wall); stone entrance m_b08_genkan (349)

fac_ship._doc: Stern's Shipyard and the harbors: Sapphire's teal hexagon floor = bs_yuka_a (texture set 330, Black 2's Battle Subway platform floor, 64x64 texels at 1 texel per unit); grey metal panel walls in22_kabe03 (303, Poké Transfer Lab); grey entrance in22_yuka04 (303). Sapphire's olive workshop floor = floor_tex in77k_yuka1 (379, Plasma Frigate deck plate) in the recipes

fac_pyre._doc: Mt. Pyre = Black 2's Celestial Tower (texture set 323): cobblestone floor in42_fl01 (64x32 texels: the recipes lay it with a floor_tex at 64x32 units), the tower's arched wall in42_wl01 (32x64 texels over the 50-unit wall: u_size 25), stone strip entrance in42_fl02

fac_tomb._doc: Block style: Celestial Tower's tomb slab (tomb02, set 323) stretched once over each stone's top; the sides use the slab texture's plain edge; 14 units high (the tower's slabs are 13)

fac_rail._doc: Block style: a low balustrade for Sapphire's walls between two levels (Celestial Tower's ornate railing in42_slop02 on the faces, its stone strip in42_fl02 on top)

fac_partition._doc: Block style: Sapphire's white partition walls inside the shipyard: a 40-unit wall of the shipyard's grey panels (in22_kabe03, set 303) with a white top (b03_wall_a, set 330: the cream-white station wall)

fac_railing._doc: Block style: a thin metal railing (Sapphire's grey railings around the harbor pool, the cable car pits and the Space Center's window walk): the grey bar railing in67saku (set 348, transparent between the bars) on the faces, the grey metal in22_yuka04 (303) on its 3-unit top

fac_harbor._doc: The harbors (area 351 = Black 2's Humilau, whose texture animation 21 moves in70_sea1): Sapphire's teal hexagon floor = bs_yuka_a (330), the building's grey wall in22_kabe03 (303), grey entrance in22_yuka04 (303)

fac_pool._doc: Block style: the harbor's sunken pool: Humilau's sea in70_sea1 (set 351, animated in area 351) 16 units below the floor; its side faces (the pool's west/east walls) Black 2's sewer concrete 17kabe00 (298)

fac_space._doc: The Space Center (area 338 = Black 2's Medal Office / Castelia research office): Sapphire's grey stone floor = in57_yuka02 (blue-grey stone, set 338), its light wall = in57_kabe01 (cream panels, 338), grey entrance in22_yuka04 (303)

fac_pillar._doc: Block style: a white pillar (Space Center 2F's west pillar): the cream panel wall in57_kabe01 (338) on its faces, white b03_wall_a (330) on top

fac_station._doc: The cable car stations (area 330 = Black 2's Gear Station): Sapphire's grey tile floor = chip_yuka (the grey tile every interior set has; 16 units), its white wall = b03_wall_a (330, the Battle Subway's white wall), grey entrance in22_yuka04 (303)

fac_track._doc: Block style: the cable's track along the platform (Sapphire row 3), sunk 10 units like the Gear Station's tracks: rails bs_senro_d (330) on the bottom, the platform edge bs_kiwa (330) on the sides

fac_drop._doc: Block style: Sapphire's dark drops beside the boarding walkway (rows 5-6), 40 units deep: the Gear Station's track bed gs_senro (330) at the bottom, its grey wall bs_wall_c (330) on the sides

fac_planks._doc: Block style: Sapphire's orange plank stacks in the shipyard: Black 2's vertical wood planks in48_tile03 (set 329) on top and faces, 32 units high

fac_girder._doc: Block style: Sapphire's lattice girders in the shipyard: a thin 44-unit column of Black 2's metal lattice in20_saku02 (set 301, open between the bars) with a grey metal cap in22_yuka04 (303)

fac_grave._doc: Block style (sweep_rooms 2026-10-07): Mt. Pyre's upright grey gravestone (user choice, notes/DECISIONS.md: grey upright stones like Sapphire's, not the Celestial Tower's pale blue slabs): Black 2's smooth grey stone in82_ishi (set 389) on every face, shaded light at the top; 10 x 5 units, 18 high, on a fac_grave_base

fac_grave_base._doc: Block style (sweep_rooms): the gravestone's low base, the Celestial Tower's grey stone d17_wall_a (set 323), 14 x 8 units, 3 high
